ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Performance. Through the creation of live performances, this interdisciplinary studio class will examine the creative process, site, audience, and presence. The work will include readings, discussion, studio exercises, and critique. Sitting at the crossroads of visual art, design, film/video, sound, music, dance, theater, stand-up, religion, architecture, sociology, and technology, the semester will culminate with a show entirely produced and performed by the group. Undergraduate Section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Fine & Applied Arts. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
